subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should ordinary `message(action="send")` stop seeing or stop honoring poll creation fields, or should non-empty `pollQuestion` and `pollOption` continue to reject send as explicit poll intent?
rationale: Current code intentionally accepts metadata-only padding but still rejects content-bearing poll fields; changing that boundary affects shared tool schemas and channel delivery semantics across Feishu, Telegram, Discord, and other message-tool channels.

options.title: Action-scope poll fields
options.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `poll` actions or channel-specific poll tools so normal sends cannot be polluted by poll schema fields while explicit poll validation stays strict.

options.title: Strip poll fields on send
options.body: Treat `action="send"` as authoritative and remove poll creation params before delivery, improving send reliability but potentially hiding mistaken poll calls.

options.title: Keep strict content guard
options.body: Continue rejecting non-empty poll content on send and require live evidence before changing the model-facing contract further.

recommendation.title: Action-scope poll fields
recommendation.body: Expose poll creation fields only for `poll` actions or channel-specific poll tools so normal sends cannot be polluted by poll schema fields while explicit poll validation stays strict.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged poll gating and schema consistency work is the strongest history signal for the shared send/poll contract boundary.
